card.name: Art awards and museum biographies
card.fires_on: Words in artist and museum biographies, just before a named grant, prize, series or institution. Examples are the year, 'a' or 'the' after 'recipient of' or 'awarded'.

modes.label: Before a named grant
modes.description: A year, 'a' or 'the' right before a named grant or prize in an artist bio.
modes.example: A recent recipient of<< a>> 2006 Joan Mitchell Foundation

modes.label: Before a named collection or place
modes.description: A small word or adjective before a named series, gallery or shipyard.
modes.example: is part of the<< new>> Polymer Series (2011).

card.writes: It seems to push toward names of awards, funds and institutions, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on small words in art-world biographies just before a named prize, grant or institution.
